onboarding.heroHeadline: An AI notebook for back-to-back meetings
onboarding.featuresTitle: Stay in the meeting. Notes are on us.
onboarding.featureMic: Uses your phone mic — nothing else required
onboarding.featurePrivacy: Private by default; share only when you choose
onboarding.featureConnect: Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, and any other meeting app
onboarding.beforeTitle: I help you prepare before the meeting
onboarding.beforeBody: Jalase syncs with your calendar and prepares context before external meetings: who is joining, what you discussed last time, and what matters now.
onboarding.duringTitle: Give the conversation your full attention
onboarding.duringBody: Stop choosing between listening and note-taking. Write as much or as little as you like — I turn the conversation into clear, personal notes.
onboarding.afterTitle: Notes, action items, and follow-ups are ready when the meeting ends
onboarding.afterBody: So you can move work forward right away.
onboarding.ctaSubtitle: Sign in and capture your first meeting
